notes.title: Sportvida CyberDash is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/9d71867ecea524b1c274aed5fcc77a64a5ec374e.png[/img]

Thank you all for your incredible support and patience!
Sportvida CyberDash is now officially released! After numerous updates and community testing, we’ve made major improvements to controls, visual cues, and overall game stability—based directly on your feedback.

Strap on your headset, swing your arms, and dive into a high-speed futuristic world of light and technology. Sprint, dodge, and smash your way through intense VR challenges that deliver a powerful physical release. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast or just looking to unwind, this game helps you find your rhythm and rediscover the joy of movement.

✅ [b]Original Levels[/b]

notes.title: Sportvida CyberDash Release Delayed to May 20
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/cc83545ed74a7b3f787bb55908a529399b1b9917.jpg[/img]
Dear CyberDashers,

We've decided to postpone CyberDash's launch until May 20th. 
In the past month, we've been hard at work adding more content to CyberDash, but we've run out of time to implement all the changes and features we want to add for our 1.0 release.
We're adding over 10 new "forward-facing 180° track" levels. We've also been continuously improving and optimizing the game based on fan and demo feedback..

Thank you so much for your understanding, and we can't wait to get Sportvida CyberDash into your hands next month.

notes.title: Sportvida CyberDash Release Delayed to April 11
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/4b70893629c437526316b80eb4959874a8930348.png[/img]
Unfortunately, the Steam release of Sportvida CyberDash will be delayed for 3 weeks. The new date is April 11th. We're introducing two new modes to the game: Race Mode & Dodge Mode, and sadly, this means we need a little bit more time to get it just right.
󠀠
We're almost at the finish line and excited for players to experience Sportvida CyberDash on PC. Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: HOW FAST CAN YOU RUN!?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/54979ebc90bd64abdc8312e0db069b3d70f6de20.png[/img]

[b]Sportvida CyberDash[/b] introduces two brand-new exhilarating modes to elevate your running experience!

✅ [b]Race Mode[/b] – No speed limits, no obstacles—push yourself to the max and break your top speed!
✅ [b]Dodge Mode[/b] – No speed limits, randomized obstacles—test your reflexes and agility to the limit!

That’s not all!
Alongside these exciting new modes, Strike Mode still delivers an action-packed impact experience!
✅ [b]Strike Mode[/b] – Run while punching, slashing, or ramming obstacles for an intense impact experience!

🚀 Dash at full speed, feel the thrill, and sharpen your reflexes!
🔥 Try it now in the Steam Demo!
󠀠
Add the game to your wishlist now and get ready for the official release on [b]May 20th[/b]! 🎮
